title: Tier-partitioned mission archive: layout, io enforcement, and compat resolution
summary: Rules for moving the mission archive to active/archive/missions/<tier>/<tenant|shared>/<id> so archived confidential content gets io-layer tenant enforcement.
hint_triggers: (1) Mirror the active layout in the archive — <tier>/<tenant|shared>/<id> — so tenant_scope.protected_prefixes and the same slug extraction apply with no new machinery; an untenanted confidential archive goes under <tier>/shared/ where the invalid-slug path fails closed for bound processes. (2) validateReadPermission early-allows everything outside knowledge/organizations/projects/floors — new protected roots must also join that read gate, not only tenant_scope.protected_prefixes, or reads keep default-allow. (3) Scope a new protected root conservatively: gating active/missions/ reads broke readers legitimately governed at the app layer; gating archive reads only preserved behavior. (4) A partitioned store needs one resolver that probes both layouts — findArchivedMissionDir returns the flat or partitioned dir, prefers stated dirs, and throws OWNER_AMBIGUOUS — then repoint writers and let scanners depth-walk. (5) Migrating existing dirs is mechanical: tier+tenant come from each dir's mission-state.json; stateless legacy dirs stay flat and remain resolvable.
